title: User temporary files
whyItMatters: The per-user temp folder often holds leftovers from documents and installers that can include private data.
source: Per-user temporary directory %LOCALAPPDATA%/Temp; standard Windows application temp location
notes: Higher cap because the folder can be large. File names and sizes only; contents are never opened.

steps: Close every open program, including installers that are still running.
Open Settings > System > Storage > Cleanup recommendations and review Temporary files.
Select the temporary files and remove them.
cleanup.risk: Removes the temporary files of this account. Unsaved work in open programs and running installers can be lost.
cleanup.source: Microsoft Support, Free up drive space in Windows: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/experience/storage-filemanagement/free-up-drive-space-in-windows
